approach: Fault starts in two places. (1) reading.rs: the failed-reading commit in `first_reading` and `correct` drops the error text that `read_for` returns; it is carried to the caller in `Proposal.reader_error` but never committed. Fix: add a small helper that appends the redacted, length-capped error to the commit body when no reading was made, used by both commits. (2) The drain's second attempt for an unread Proposed job calls `go`, which bails ("has no reading yet") and counts as a second failure, so `Stop::RepeatedFailure` fires and the reader is never asked again. Fix in core: `go_job`'s Proposed-with-no-reading arm re-reads through a new `read_unread` (same code as `first_reading`, no request record, with the next invocation seq and spent taken from the job's records) and returns `GoResult::Reread`. Fix in drain.rs: in `run_job`, for a `ReadOf::Queued` read that was not pre-read and came back with a job but a reader error, return a new `RunStep::Unread(reason)` and print the reason on the drain line. `attempts` counts unread results separately from `failures`: the first one loops once (the existing second attempt now really re-reads); the second ends the item as new `ItemEnd::Skipped`, with a note naming the reason, and `finish` ignores it, so no stop is set and the next item runs. Failures after a read, retries (`ReadOf::Retry`), and go errors with no job stay on the old path. No new record type or data file.

decisions.choice: Make the drain's re-read happen by changing `go_job` (Proposed, no reading) to read again and return `GoResult::Reread`, not by adding a Steps method.
decisions.reason: RealSteps::read(Queued) already calls `go`; the second attempt then re-reads with no new trait method or stub changes. It also matches what `go` already does for a Queued job, and the old error was only a pointer to `athena correct`. No existing test pins the old message (only run/mod.rs contains it).

rejected.option: RealSteps::read calls `athena.correct(job, "<fixed line>")` for an unread job
rejected.why: Needs an invented correction line, and the commit says 'after a correction' with the body 'The user's one-line correction', which is false.

rejected.option: Add a new Steps method `reread_unread` with a default
rejected.why: More surface (trait, stubs, RealSteps) for the same effect; `Steps::reread` is already meant for stale readings and RealSteps does not implement it.

decisions.choice: Put the error in the commit body of the failed-reading commit (and the same for the correction path), redacted and capped; not in a record.
decisions.reason: Criteria ask for the error in the commit or record; a body line avoids touching the records allow-list and round-trip test. Redaction matches how the correction line is already treated; if redaction fails the body says the text was withheld, so the commit never fails because of it.

rejected.option: Add an error field to the Invocation or Reading record
rejected.why: Changes record schema, the allow-list and the round-trip test; out of the small change.

decisions.choice: Count unread results apart from `failures` in `attempts`; the second one ends the item as `ItemEnd::Skipped` (no stop) with a note carrying the reason.
decisions.reason: Keeps `Stop::RepeatedFailure` and `ATTEMPTS` untouched for jobs that were read, as criterion 8 requires, and bounds the re-read to one per item.

rejected.option: Return `ItemEnd::Failed` on the second unread result
rejected.why: Sets RepeatedFailure, which is the bug.

rejected.option: Change `ATTEMPTS` or count the first unread result as no attempt at all
rejected.why: Would alter the rule for every failure.

decisions.choice: Restrict the new `Unread` path to `ReadOf::Queued` with `!pre_read` and `read.job.is_some() && read.error.is_some()`.
decisions.reason: A retry (`ReadOf::Retry`) makes a new job and go-errors with `job: None` (lock held, stopped, budget) are different failures; the brief says only unread jobs change.

rejected.option: Treat every read error as unread
rejected.why: Would change the repeated-failure rule for retries and for go errors.

decisions.choice: Show the reason on the drain line by extending `push` to append `: <reason>` only when the outcome is `not read`.
decisions.reason: The error then appears in the drain log for the item without altering lines for other outcomes that existing tests may match.

rejected.option: Print the reason for every outcome
rejected.why: Changes many existing lines and risks old assertions.

decisions.choice: Test the drain with the real `RealSteps` and a wrapped `Scenario` script that sets `turn.structured = None` for the first item's reader calls (ReadError::Failed: 'the reader returned no structured reading'), not a refused reading.
decisions.reason: A refused reading makes `read_for` run the reader twice inside one read, which would hide whether the drain re-read; the no-structured-output failure runs the reader once per read, so 'exactly twice' means one re-read. The request has acceptance bullets so the plan pass does not read it first.

rejected.why: The stub cannot show the error in a committed record or the real go re-read.

files.purpose: Add `failed_reading_body` (appends the redacted, capped reader error to the commit body when no reading was made) and use it in `first_reading` and `correct`. Give `first_reading` an optional prior `&JobRecords` so a re-read uses `next_seq()`, `n = 1` and the job's spent; add `pub(crate) read_unread` using it with subject 'Read a request again (the reader failed)' / 'Read a request again: <title>' and no request record.
In `go_job`, the `JobState::Proposed` arm with `latest_reading() == None` calls `read_unread` and returns `GoResult::Reread` instead of bailing. One arm only.

Add `RunStep::Unread(String)` returned from `run_job` for an unread `ReadOf::Queued` read with a job and an error; `push` appends the reason for outcome 'not read'; `attempts` counts unread results apart from `failures` and ends the second as new `ItemEnd::Skipped` with a note; `finish` treats Skipped as no stop; update the `JobLine` doc and the `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc to say unread jobs are skipped.
Add the two real-steps tests (skip after one re-read with the error visible and the next item run; re-read that succeeds runs the item).
Add tests that a no-structured-output read commits the error text and that `go` on that job re-reads once.
One Unreleased entry for the committed and printed reader error and the one re-read then skip.

steps: In reading.rs add `failed_reading_body(base, error, redactor)`: base body, then 'The reader gave no usable reading: <error>' when the error is Some, redacted (fallback sentence on redaction failure), trimmed and capped (about 1000 chars). Use it in `first_reading` and in `correct`'s body.

In reading.rs give `first_reading` a `prior: Option<&JobRecords>` argument (callers: the `ask` path passes None, `read_queued` passes None); when Some, use `seq = prior.next_seq()`, `spent = prior.spent_usd()` and the 'again' subjects. Add `pub(crate) fn read_unread(&self, job: &JobRecords, ui) -> Result<Proposal>` mirroring `read_queued` (stopped check, head, JobConfig, records, request, first_reading with with_request false).

In run/mod.rs replace the `None => bail!(...)` arm of the Proposed match in `go_job` with `None => self.read_unread(&job, ui).map(|p| GoResult::Reread(Box::new(p)))`. Keep the `Some(_) => unreachable!` arm.

In drain.rs add `RunStep::Unread(String)` and `ItemEnd::Skipped`. In `run_job`, in the `(_, error, _)` arm, return `Unread(reason)` when `matches!(from, ReadOf::Queued(_)) && !pre_read && read.job.is_some() && read.error.is_some()`, after pushing the line (outcome 'not read', reason the error); otherwise the old Failed return. Extend `push` to print `: <reason>` for outcome 'not read'.

In `attempts` keep `let mut unread = 0;`. On `RunStep::Unread(reason)`: `unread += 1`; if `unread >= 2`, add a note 'item <id> is skipped: <reason>' and return `ItemEnd::Skipped`; else `continue` the loop without touching `failures` (re-check `stop_requested` at the top as now). In `finish` add `ItemEnd::Skipped` to the no-stop arm. Fix the `JobLine` and `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc text.

Add tests in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs: a read with `turn.structured = None` commits the `reader_error` text (git show of `proposal.commit`), and `go` on that job with a working reader returns `Reread` with a reading after exactly one more reader call.

Add the two tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs using `real_steps_with`, `Lines`, `RecordingLander`, `rated_scenario()` wrapped in a closure that clears `structured` for the first request's reader calls (all but the first call in the success test), with a counter, and asserting everything listed under criteria 1 and 2.
Add the CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased in plain words.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; fix failures, paying attention to the existing RepeatedFailure tests.

risks.risk: `athena go <id>` on an unread Proposed job now re-reads (spends reader budget) instead of printing a hint.
risks.mitigation: Only `go_job`'s unread-Proposed arm changes, and it returns the same `GoResult::Reread` as the Queued arm. A pin test covers it; the full test run checks no test relied on the bail.

risks.risk: The re-read could loop or overspend.
risks.mitigation: Drain bounds it to one re-read per item through the unread counter; `go_job` itself has no loop. The reader's per-job budget check (`check_budget`, `spent` from `job.spent_usd()`) still applies.

risks.risk: Invocation record path collision (seq 1 reused) on re-read.
risks.mitigation: `read_unread` takes `seq = job.next_seq()`; the pin test runs `ask` then `go` and loads the records, which fails on a duplicate invocation path.

risks.risk: A long or multi-line error, or secret text in the reader's output, ends up in a commit.
risks.mitigation: Cap the error at a fixed length, trim it, and keep it in the body, not the subject. Redaction failure falls back to a fixed sentence.

risks.risk: The new branch changes behavior for retries, go errors or read-ahead items.
risks.mitigation: `Unread` is returned only for `ReadOf::Queued`, `!pre_read`, `job.is_some() && error.is_some()`; the existing RepeatedFailure tests in tests/drain.rs are rerun.

risks.risk: Existing assertions on drain log lines break.
risks.mitigation: `push` adds the reason only for outcome 'not read'; run the full drain tests and `display` tests.

demonstrations.method: New test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. Entry point: `drain::drain(&steps, limits(50.0), &lines)` with `real_steps_with(&athena, &lander, &lines)`; `athena` from `fx.athena(script)` (exists today). Precondition: two queued requests, each with an acceptance bullet (like the text at tests/drain.rs ~2020) so the plan has no missing parts and the first read happens in `attempts`. Seam: wrap `rated_scenario().script()` in a closure that, for Role::Reader whose `user_prompt` contains the first request's text, counts the call and sets `turn.structured = None` (FakeTurn.structured is pub; the Script seam exists in `Fixture::athena`); every other call is the unchanged scenario. `lines` is `common::Lines` (exists). The logic under test (go, read_queued, drain) is real; only the model output is faked.
demonstrations.observes: Reader calls for item one equal 2; a `Lines` entry starting `drain` contains 'the reader returned no structured reading'; `fx.git.run(["log","--format=%B","--grep","the reader failed"])` output contains the same text; the lander recorded the second item's job (the drain ran the next item).
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the commit-body change the `git log` text has no error text; without the `go` re-read the reader runs once, not twice; without the Skipped end the item ends RepeatedFailure and the second item is never run, so the assertions on reader count, lander and the next item fail.

demonstrations.method: Same test as criterion 1 (second part) plus a second new test. Entry point and seam as in 1. Test A asserts on the returned `Report`: `report.stop != Stop::RepeatedFailure`, `report.jobs[0].outcome == "not read"` with `reason` containing the error text, a `report.notes` entry containing 'skipped' and the error text, and `display::drain(&report)` showing the reason. Test B: the script fails the reader only on its first call for the item, then behaves normally.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain -- a_reader_that_gives_no_reading a_re_read_that_succeeds_runs_the_item
demonstrations.observes: Test A: no repeated-failure stop, the skipped item reported with its reason. Test B: reader called twice, `report.landed == 1`, stop is QueueEmpty (or not RepeatedFailure), lander has the item's job.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the Skipped end the stop is RepeatedFailure and `report.jobs[0].reason` has no skip note; without the go re-read the second test's item never lands because the second attempt bails.

demonstrations.method: New tests in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs beside `a_reader_that_does_not_complete_is_not_read_again` (~line 1763). Entry point: `athena.ask("study the demo", &Quiet)` built with the existing `repo`, `athena_with` and a `Tweak` that sets `turn.structured = None` for Role::Reader (the same seam that test uses today). Then `go` on that job with a working reader: assert it returns `GoResult::Reread` with a reading, with no invocation seq collision and the reader called exactly twice in total. demonstrations.observes: `proposal.reader_error` is Some; `git.run(["show","-s","--format=%B",&proposal.commit])` contains the `reader_error` text; for the go re-read, the commit subject starts 'Read a request again'.
